{{tl|Infobox clergy}} may be added by pasting the template as shown below into an article and then filling in the desired fields. Any parameters left blank or omitted will not be displayed.

In addition to clergy-specific parameters, this template accepts any parameter that {{tl|Infobox person}} does. See [[Template:Infobox person/doc#Parameters|here]] for a complete list.

== Usage ==
Commonly-used parameters:
{{Parameter names example | honorific_prefix | name | honorific_suffix | image | image_size={{{image_size}}}<br /> | alt | caption | native_name | pronunciation | birth_name | birth_date | birth_place | death_date | death_place | death_cause | other_names | citizenship | education | alma_mater | occupation | years_active | religion | spouse | children | parents | relatives | known_for | church | ordained | laicized | writings | congregations | offices_held | title | website | signature={{{signature}}}<br /> | signature_alt | footnotes | module }}

== Embedding other templates ==
The {{para|module}} parameter may used to embed other templates into this infobox (see [[Wikipedia:Infobox modules]]).

== Use as a child template ==
The '''child''' parameter is used when embedding this infobox into another.

{{Infobox person module documentation |template=Infobox clergy |parameter=child}}

== Tracking categories ==
* {{clc|Pages using infobox clergy with unknown parameters}}
* {{clc|Pages using infobox clergy with conflicting parameters}}
* {{clc|Pages using infobox clergy with deprecated parameters}}
* {{clc|No local image but image on Wikidata}} – Used by [[Template:Wikidata image]] to track articles where an infobox has no image but [[Wikidata]] has an image name. To exclude articles from this category, add an image or {{para|nocat_wdimage|yes}} to the infobox.
